main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-bar forward return minus normal drift on post_pipeline_value
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 over at least 300 cases confirms (with timing gain > 0); t <= -2 over at least 300 cases rejects

supporting_check.name: timing gain before costs (mean daily book return minus position x coin mean daily return)

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more over at least 300 cases and the timing gain before costs is above 0.
reading: Slope is an OLS with intercept on grid bars 0,5,10,... of each window (pooled), normal drift is each coin's mean grid 5-bar return over all its windows, and the timing gain uses each bar as a day, the book's daily return being the mean over coins of position x next-bar return.
